title: Cosmic Dragon Sorcerer
description: A green-skinned figure in a white fedora and glowing purple glasses holds a large translucent orb containing a golden dragonfly. A green alien clings to his shoulder while a massive purple dragon breathes orange fire toward a swirling galaxy portal below. A second dragonfly flies near the bottom over cosmic clouds and nebulae.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a smirking green-skinned humanoid in a white fedora and purple glasses wearing a green hoodie, holding a glowing blue orb with a large golden dragonfly inside. A small green alien clings to his right shoulder. A giant purple eastern dragon coils around them breathing orange fire toward a swirling galaxy portal at the bottom. Another dragonfly flies in the foreground. Swirling purple nebulae, galaxies, green moon, dramatic clouds, and vibrant cosmic energy fill the background.
